note: The dated version history of every canonical policy page in apps/web/lib/legal-constants.ts. The last version of each must match the text the page publishes and the date it prints; scripts/check-policy-versions.mjs fails when either moves alone. A change that leaves the date where it is appends a version with a note saying why it is editorial. recordedSince is the day these histories began: a policy whose first version is dated after it is listed on /changelog with that version's summary. Each record in publications names a day production was checked, a commit on main that prints the dates production served then, and main's head at that moment, so a replaced version says whether it applied on this site or was replaced before it was published here. The workflow is in docs/compliance/README.md.
